text: Dovršite poslovicu: „Tko rano rani, … grabi.”
gloss: Complete the proverb: "He who rises early, grabs ... " — Two fortunes: the proverb "Tko rano rani, dvije sreće grabi".

text: U utrci pretekneš trkača koji je drugi. Na kojem si mjestu sada?
gloss: In a race you overtake the runner who is second. What place are you in now? — Second: you take his place; passing the runner in second does not put you first.

text: Koji je kontinent gotovo u cijelosti prekriven ledom i nema stalnih stanovnika, samo istraživače?
gloss: Which continent is almost entirely covered in ice and has no permanent residents, only researchers? — Antarctica.

text: Pizza margherita nosi boje talijanske zastave: crvenu daje rajčica, bijelu mozzarella. Koja začinska biljka daje zelenu?
gloss: Pizza margherita carries the colours of the Italian flag: red tomato, white mozzarella. Which herb gives the green? — Basil.

text: Hrvatska je do 2023. plaćala valutom nazvanom po maloj životinji. Po kojoj?
gloss: Until 2023 Croatia paid with a currency named after a small animal. Which? — The marten (kuna).

text: Koja velika ptica selica, bijela s crnim krilima i crvenim kljunom, gradi gnijezda na dimnjacima i krovovima, a u priči „donosi” bebe?
gloss: Which large migratory bird, white with black wings and a red beak, nests on chimneys and roofs and "brings" babies in the story? — The white stork (roda).

text: Koji hrvatski naziv mjeseca doslovno znači „pad lišća”?
gloss: Which Croatian month name literally means "fall of leaves"? — Listopad (October): list(će) + pad; a word-building clue.

text: Tko je napisala „Čudnovate zgode šegrta Hlapića”, najpoznatiju hrvatsku pripovijest o postolarskom šegrtu?
gloss: Who wrote "The Strange Adventures of Hlapić the Apprentice"? — Ivana Brlić-Mažuranić (1913).

text: Utakmica je završila s ukupno pet postignutih golova, a domaćin je pobijedio s jednim golom razlike. Koji je bio rezultat?
gloss: A match ended with five goals in total and the home side won by one goal. What was the score? — 3:2; the other scores have a wrong sum or margin.

text: Koji je žuti Pokémon sa strelastim repom i crvenim obrazima koji ispušta struju?
gloss: Which yellow Pokémon with a lightning-bolt tail and red cheeks gives off electricity? — Pikachu.

text: Koji je vladar oko 925. godine postao prvi hrvatski kralj?
gloss: Which ruler became the first Croatian king around 925? — Tomislav; the others are later or earlier Croatian rulers.

text: Riječ „oktava” dolazi od latinskog „octo”, osam. Koliko bijelih tipki na klaviru obuhvaća oktava ako se broje oba krajnja „do”?
gloss: The word "octave" comes from Latin "octo", eight. How many white piano keys does an octave span, counting both end Cs? — 8: C D E F G A B C. 12 and 13 count the black keys too.

text: Nikola Tesla rođen je 1856. u selu Smiljan. U kojem se hrvatskom kraju ono nalazi?
gloss: Nikola Tesla was born in 1856 in the village of Smiljan. In which Croatian region is it? — Lika (near Gospić).

text: Koji je hrvatski tenisač 2001. osvojio Wimbledon kao igrač s pozivnicom organizatora, takozvanim wild cardom?
gloss: Which Croatian tennis player won Wimbledon in 2001 as a wild card? — Goran Ivanišević, the only wild card to win the tournament.

text: Koja hrvatska riječ znači i povrće zbog kojeg plačemo pri rezanju i oružje iz kojeg se ispucavaju strijele?
gloss: Which Croatian word means both the vegetable that makes us cry when cut and the weapon that shoots arrows? — Luk (onion / bow); the others are homonyms for other things.

text: Što je glavni uzrok godišnjih doba na Zemlji?
gloss: What is the main cause of the seasons on Earth? — The tilt of Earth's axis; the distance trap fails because the Earth is closest to the Sun in early January.

text: Koji broj slijedi u nizu: 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, …?
gloss: Which number comes next: 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, ...? — 13; each term is the sum of the two before it (Fibonacci).

text: Koji je jedini sisavac koji doista leti, a ne samo klizi zrakom?
gloss: Which is the only mammal that truly flies rather than merely glides? — The bat; the flying squirrel glides, the hummingbird is a bird, the flying fish is a fish.

text: Koja je andska civilizacija u 15. stoljeću podigla Machu Picchu, grad visoko u planinama Perua?
gloss: Which Andean civilization built Machu Picchu, a city high in the mountains of Peru, in the 15th century? — The Incas; Maya, Aztecs and Olmecs lived in Mesoamerica.

text: Koji je nizozemski slikar naslikao „Zvjezdanu noć”?
gloss: Which Dutch painter painted "The Starry Night"? — Vincent van Gogh (1889); the others are also Dutch painters.

text: Tko je napisao roman „Zlatarovo zlato”, smješten u Zagreb 16. stoljeća?
gloss: Who wrote the novel "The Goldsmith's Gold", set in 16th-century Zagreb? — August Šenoa (1871).

text: Na kojoj se planini nalazi najviši vrh Hrvatske, visok 1831 metar?
gloss: On which mountain is the highest peak of Croatia, 1,831 metres high? — Dinara (Sinjal).

text: Dodir palca na nozi golemog brončanog kipa Grgura Ninskog, djela Ivana Meštrovića, prema vjerovanju donosi sreću. U kojem gradu stoji taj kip?
gloss: Touching the toe of the huge bronze statue of Gregory of Nin, by Ivan Meštrović, is said to bring luck. In which city does it stand? — Split (north of the Golden Gate of Diocletian's Palace).

text: Kravata je ime dobila po plaćenicima iz 17. stoljeća, čiji su šareni rupci oko vrata oduševili Francuze. Iz koje su zemlje dolazili?
gloss: The cravat got its name from 17th-century mercenaries whose neckerchiefs delighted the French. Which country did they come from? — Croatia ("cravate" is from "Croate"); the sound of "kravata" is a clue.

text: Računalo sve zapisuje nulama i jedinicama. Koji se broj u binarnom zapisu piše kao 101?
gloss: A computer writes everything with zeros and ones. Which number is written 101 in binary? — 5 (4 + 0 + 1).

text: Koja ptica može lebdjeti u mjestu i letjeti unatrag?
gloss: Which bird can hover in place and fly backwards? — The hummingbird.

text: Rimljani su grčkog Zeusa zvali Jupiter, a Afroditu Venera. Kako su zvali Hermesa, brzog glasnika bogova?
gloss: The Romans called Greek Zeus Jupiter and Aphrodite Venus. What did they call Hermes, the swift messenger of the gods? — Mercury; Vulcan is Hephaestus, Neptune is Poseidon, Saturn is Cronus.

text: Koji je prvi dugometražni film u cijelosti nastao računalnom animacijom, izašao 1995.?
gloss: Which was the first feature film made entirely with computer animation, released in 1995? — Toy Story ("Priča o igračkama").

text: Pet strojeva za pet minuta izradi pet igračaka. Koliko je minuta potrebno da sto strojeva izradi sto igračaka?
gloss: Five machines make five toys in five minutes. How long do 100 machines need for 100 toys? — 5 minutes: each machine makes one toy in five minutes.

text: Kvasac u tijestu „jede” šećer i pritom oslobađa plin koji tijesto podiže. Koji je to plin?
gloss: Yeast in dough "eats" sugar and releases a gas that makes the dough rise. Which gas? — Carbon dioxide.

text: Koji je grad na Jadranu 1416. donio zakon o zabrani trgovine robljem, među prvima u Europi?
gloss: Which Adriatic city passed a law banning the slave trade in 1416, among the first in Europe? — Dubrovnik.

text: Dražen Petrović u NBA ligi igrao je za dva kluba. U kojem je proveo posljednje dvije sezone?
gloss: Dražen Petrović played for two NBA clubs. Which did he spend his last two seasons with? — The New Jersey Nets (1991-93), after Portland (1989-91).

text: Hrvatski seizmolog Andrija Mohorovičić otkrio je 1909. granicu koja danas nosi njegovo ime. Što ona razdvaja?
gloss: The Croatian seismologist Andrija Mohorovičić discovered in 1909 a boundary that bears his name. What does it separate? — The Earth's crust and mantle (the Moho).

text: Hrvatski broji prema dugoj ljestvici: milijun, milijarda, pa tek onda bilijun. Čemu je jednak bilijun?
gloss: Croatian counts on the long scale: million, milliard, and only then "bilijun". What is a bilijun equal to? — A thousand milliards (10^12); a thousand millions is a milliard.

text: Čovječja ribica, bijelo i gotovo slijepo stvorenje iz podzemnih voda dinarskog krša, unatoč imenu nije riba. Kojoj životinjskoj skupini pripada?
gloss: The olm ("human fish"), a white, almost blind creature of Dinaric karst waters, is not a fish despite its name. Which group does it belong to? — Amphibians.

text: Tko se, zbog algoritma za Babbageov Analitički stroj iz 1843., često naziva prvom programerkom u povijesti?
gloss: Who is often called the first programmer in history because of an 1843 algorithm for Babbage's Analytical Engine? — Ada Lovelace.

text: Tko je režirao „Građanina Kanea” (1941.) i u njemu odigrao naslovnu ulogu?
gloss: Who directed "Citizen Kane" (1941) and played the title role? — Orson Welles.

text: Prije koncerta cijeli se orkestar ugađa prema tonu a. Koji instrument obično daje taj ton?
gloss: Before a concert the whole orchestra tunes to the note A. Which instrument usually gives it? — The oboe.

text: Kad je u Zagrebu 18 sati, koliko je sati u Los Angelesu (u većem dijelu godine)?
gloss: When it is 18:00 in Zagreb, what time is it in Los Angeles (most of the year)? — 9:00; the zones are nine hours apart except for a few weeks when the two daylight-saving changes do not line up.

text: Samo jedan od ovih brojeva nije prost. Koji?
gloss: Only one of these numbers is not prime. Which? — 91 = 7 x 13; the others are prime.

text: Splitski humanist Marko Marulić, autor „Judite”, u izgubljenom je spisu s početka 16. stoljeća, prema poznatim izvorima, prvi upotrijebio naziv jedne današnje znanosti. Koje?
gloss: The Split humanist Marko Marulić, author of "Judita", is according to known sources the first to use the name of a present-day science, in a lost early-16th-century treatise. Which? — Psychology ("psichiologia").

text: Šibenčanin Faust Vrančić u knjizi „Machinae novae” (oko 1615.) nacrtao je napravu zvanu „Homo volans”, latinski „leteći čovjek”. Što je to?
gloss: In "Machinae novae" (c. 1615) Faust Vrančić of Šibenik drew a device called "Homo volans", "flying man". What is it? — A parachute.

text: U hrvatskoj abecedi dž, lj i nj broje se kao zasebna slova. Koliko slova ima ta abeceda?
gloss: In the Croatian alphabet dž, lj and nj count as separate letters. How many letters does it have? — 30: 22 basic Latin letters + č ć đ š ž + dž lj nj.

text: Na kojem se hrvatskom otoku uzdiže Vidova gora, najviši vrh svih jadranskih otoka?
gloss: On which Croatian island does Vidova gora rise, the highest peak of all Adriatic islands? — Brač (778 m).

text: Riječ „robot” u svjetske je jezike stigla iz Čapekove drame iz 1920. Što je „robota” značila u njegovu, češkom jeziku?
gloss: The word "robot" came into world languages from Čapek's 1920 play. What did "robota" mean in his Czech? — Forced labour, drudgery; compare Croatian "rob" and "robija".

text: Kemijski simbol Sb za antimon izveden je iz latinske riječi. Koje?
gloss: The chemical symbol Sb for antimony derives from a Latin word. Which? — Stibium; stannum is tin, sulfur is S, argentum is silver.

text: U kojoj je europskoj istraživačkoj ustanovi Tim Berners-Lee 1989. predložio sustav koji je postao World Wide Web?
gloss: In which European research institution did Tim Berners-Lee propose in 1989 the system that became the World Wide Web? — CERN.

text: Šafran, jedan od najskupljih začina na svijetu, dobiva se iz cvijeta ljubičastog krokusa. Koji se dio cvijeta ručno bere i suši?
gloss: Saffron, one of the most expensive spices, comes from the flower of a purple crocus. Which part of the flower is picked by hand and dried? — The stigmas.

text: Koliko je različitih poteza bijelom na raspolaganju u prvom potezu šahovske partije?
gloss: How many different moves does White have on the first move of a chess game? — 20: 16 pawn moves (8 pawns x 1 or 2 squares) plus 4 knight moves.

text: U kojem se talijanskom gradu nalazi bazilika San Vitale, ukrašena bizantskim mozaicima iz 6. stoljeća?
gloss: In which Italian city is the basilica of San Vitale, decorated with 6th-century Byzantine mosaics? — Ravenna.
